# PackageRegistrar is a narrow public composition contract with a closed zone map

Source: [JSON](../../decisions/D101.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Date

2026-09-20

## Status

accepted

## Decision

`CoreX\Support\PackageRegistrar` and `RegistersNothingOnBoot` are named public API of
`corex/core`; P8.1 updates `extra.corex.public-api`, and P3 R4 accepts only these two
exact symbols, not all Support. The zone gate classifies `ViolationList`,
`InvalidConfiguration` and `SecretRef` as Foundation support. `CoreOptions` joins the
two registrar symbols and the existing composition holders in the closed COMPOSITION
list by exact path. `ALLOWED['Foundation']` remains empty, and any later Support type
remains R-Z0 until deliberately classified.

## Rationale

A cross-package contract cannot simultaneously be required and declared private.
`CoreOptions` is a boot-time composition DTO: its declared defaults deliberately name
implementations from several zones. Exact-symbol classification preserves that role
without opening Foundation or adding a wildcard Support exception.

## D101 — PackageRegistrar is a narrow public composition contract with a closed zone map

**Actor:** plan-designer/codex-gpt-5.6-sol/high
**Evidence:** `RAG:—` DA08 proves tenancy/modules must import the registrar across a
package boundary; DA09 proves `CoreOptions` imports defaults from Audit, Settings,
Departments, Features and TenancyContracts and therefore cannot be Foundation.

## Решение

`CoreX\Support\PackageRegistrar` and `RegistersNothingOnBoot` are named public API of
`corex/core`; P8.1 updates `extra.corex.public-api`, and P3 R4 accepts only these two
exact symbols, not all Support. The zone gate classifies `ViolationList`,
`InvalidConfiguration` and `SecretRef` as Foundation support. `CoreOptions` joins the
two registrar symbols and the existing composition holders in the closed COMPOSITION
list by exact path. `ALLOWED['Foundation']` remains empty, and any later Support type
remains R-Z0 until deliberately classified.

## Почему

A cross-package contract cannot simultaneously be required and declared private.
`CoreOptions` is a boot-time composition DTO: its declared defaults deliberately name
implementations from several zones. Exact-symbol classification preserves that role
without opening Foundation or adding a wildcard Support exception.

## Consequences

P6.2 owns the classifier/gate write; P7.1 and P8.1 declare their classifications; P8.2–
P8.5 and the combined P6+P7+P8 validation must pass R4/R-Z0/R-Z1 without broad
allowlists. The clean witness accepts `CoreOptions` cross-zone defaults; the existing
Foundation → SavedViews/Internal and unknown `Support/Probe.php` witnesses stay red.
